summary: Narrow campus loading road between buildings; no parked cars, nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Loading zone on a campus service road
Buildings 7-12 m away on both sides
No cars parked, no pull-off room

drivers.seclusion: Tight between General Purpose North 3 and Sir Llew Edwards Building in the middle of the campus.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow paved road with trees and building walls at the edge; no verge or bay seen.
drivers.traffic: Service and loading traffic plus pedestrians.
drivers.convention: Loading Zone Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, 2 hours max; no cars parked along it.

sun_shade: Deep shade from tall buildings and trees most of the day.
